item.title: Andrew Cuomo Warns Taxing The Rich Would Drive Wealth Out Of NYC
item.description: Former Governor of New York Andrew Cuomo says Taxing the Rich won’t work and it will just make the rich leave NYC.

item.title: House GOP Majority Narrows To 218–214 After Menefee Sworn In
item.description: The US House Republican majority now stands at 218-214 after Speaker Mike Johnson swears in Christian Menefee (D-TX)

item.title: Nurses’ Strike Enters Fourth Week As Protesters March On Hochul’s Office
item.description: Monday marked the fourth week of the nurses’ strike, as hundreds marched through Midtown to Governor Hochul’s office, blasting the governor and urging her to step in and help end the labor dispute.

item.description: New work requirements for the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) have taken effect for many recipients under changes enacted last year. item.title: Out-Of-Control Car Crashes Into Nebraska Troopers’ Roadside Stop
item.description: Nebraska state troopers narrowly avoided injury after an out-of-control vehicle slid off a slick stretch of Interstate 80 and crashed into a car they were assisting on the roadside.

item.title: Trump Plans $12B Strategic Stockpile To Cut Reliance On China For Critical Minerals
item.description: Trump plans to create a strategic stockpile of critical minerals with $12 billion in funding, aiming to reduce U.S. reliance on China for materials such as lithium, nickel, and rare earths.
